Staff put the points into the box under Data entry → Lucky Box (after taking them off the player on the platform). The system checks every deposit and withdrawal against the promotion's release rule and tells CS how much to give back. After adding the points on the platform, press Release here or on the alert. A release is also recorded as a claim of the promotion, so it counts as promotion cost.
员工先在平台上扣掉玩家的分数，再到「数据录入 → Lucky Box」存入宝箱。系统会用每一笔充值和提款对照优惠的释放条件，告诉客服要放回多少。在平台上加回分数后，在这里或提醒里点「释放」。释放也会记成这个优惠的一笔领取，所以会算进优惠成本。

Staf memasukkan poin ke box di Input data → Lucky Box (setelah mengurangi poin pemain di platform). Sistem mencocokkan setiap deposit dan penarikan dengan aturan pelepasan dan memberi tahu CS berapa yang dikembalikan. Setelah menambahkan poin di platform, tekan Lepas di sini atau di pengingat. Pelepasan juga dicatat sebagai klaim promosi, jadi dihitung sebagai biaya promosi.
